info.title: OxioPay Partner API - ATM pilot
info.summary: Identify a customer's wallet, read its balance and load it from the venue's own ATMs.
info.description:
**There is no refund and no cash withdrawal of the balance.** No route of this API pays money out of a wallet.

This is the contract for the **ATM pilot** of the OxioPay Partner API v1. The ATM network is a partner whose
ATMs stand inside the venues and only **load** balance. The ATM team builds against this document; the API is
implemented to match it, and the OpenAPI document the API serves at `GET /openapi.json` must be equivalent for
these routes.

Not in this pilot (each arrives later without breaking anything): paying with balance, charges, webhooks and the
events feed, reports, loads collected by the partner itself (agent models). Their fields, values and codes are not
described here.

**Hosts.** Every host name ending in `.example` is a placeholder until OxioPay confirms the real one.

**Marked decisions.** `x-decided-in-contract: true` marks a rule fixed by this contract.

## Conventions
- JSON in UTF-8. Amounts are integer **cents**; `currency` is always `EUR`.
- Times in answers are RFC 3339 in UTC (`Z`); accept fractional seconds. Times in requests may use `Z` or an offset.
- `business_date` is the venue's night: from 08:00 to 08:00 Europe/Madrid, named after the day the night starts.
- Public ids are a prefix plus 32 lowercase hex characters: `pc_` connection, `wl_` load. A wallet never has a
  public id. No answer carries a wallet id, a customer name, a phone, a wallet code or a ficha number.
- Lists: `?limit=1..100` (default 25) and `?cursor=` → `{object: "list", data, has_more, next_cursor}`.
- Changes inside v1 are additive: ignore fields, enum values and error codes you do not know (handle an unknown
  code by its HTTP status). Request bodies are strict: an unknown field is refused with `422 validation_failed`.
  Unknown query parameters are ignored.
- Every answer carries the header `Request-Id`. Send `X-Request-Id` (letters, digits and `-`, up to 64) to have
  your own id echoed; otherwise OxioPay generates a UUID. Log it with every call.
- Every answer carries `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- A POST without a body (a void without `reason`, the demo reset) is sent without `Content-Type`;
  `Content-Type: application/json` with an empty body → `400 invalid_request`.

## Authentication
- Server to server only. The key lives on the ATM platform's servers, never inside an ATM.
- Send the key **only** as `Authorization: Bearer oxp_live_…` (live) or `Bearer oxp_test_…` (demo). A key in the
  URL → `400 api_key_in_url` (and the owner is told to rotate it); a key in the body → `400 api_key_in_body`.
- A request with an `Origin` header → `403 browser_not_allowed`. Bodies above 16 KB → `413 body_too_large`.
- In live, the partner API answers only requests that reach it through OxioPay's own edge (its CDN), and the IP
  list is compared with the address that edge reports for your connection: your public address after your own
  NAT, outbound proxy or cloud gateway.
- In live, a key with `wallet:load` must have an IP list, and a key with a list works only from it, on every
  route (`403 ip_not_allowed`). On the demo the list is optional; when it is set, it applies the same way. Every
  new address outside the list alerts the owner, and calls from 3 such addresses within 24 hours pause new loads
  (see `POST /wallet/loads`).
- One key per venue (a connection = partner × venue). It reaches only the wallets of its venue's wallet group (the
  same check the venue's own staff use) whose home venue (the venue where the wallet was created) belongs to the
  same company (tax id) as the key's venue; a home venue without a company counts as another company.
- Reach is checked before anything else about the reference. Outside it the answer is `404 wallet_not_found`,
  with the same body as for an unknown ficha, even when the ficha is lost or blocked, its chip serial differs or
  its wallet is blocked or closed, and nothing is recorded or alerted. A valid live code of a wallet outside reach
  also answers `404 wallet_not_found`; an expired or unknown live code answers `422 live_code_invalid`.
- The ATM key holds `wallet:balance` and `wallet:load` only.
- `x-required-scope` on each operation lists the scopes that allow it (one is enough); `any` means any valid key;
  an empty list means no key.

## Idempotency
- `POST /wallet/loads` requires `Idempotency-Key` (8–200 of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`). Use the ATM's own transaction id;
  as it is also your `reference`, keep it to 8–64 of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`. Keys live per connection, forever, also
  across key rotations: never reuse one for another load.
- "The same request" means the same `amount`, `funding`, `reference`, `device`, `description` (after
  normalisation), `qr` (after trimming) and `nfc_uid` (without separators, uppercase), compared after JSON
  parsing: key order, spacing and every header other than `Idempotency-Key` do not matter.
- Same key and same request → the stored original answer (same status, same `balance_after`) with
  `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Same key, different request → `422 idempotency_key_reused`, whose `operation`
  member is the load that holds the key.
- OxioPay handles one request per Idempotency-Key at a time: a request whose key is still being processed waits
  for it (up to 10 seconds, else `503 try_later`), then gets its stored answer, or runs itself if that request was
  refused. A stored success is replayed before the `qr` is resolved and before the wallet, venue and limit checks.
- A load either commits within 30 seconds of reaching OxioPay's API or is abandoned; it never commits later.
- `401`, `403`, `404 not_found`, `429` and `503 try_later` never come from what is stored for the Idempotency-Key:
  after an attempt whose answer you did not get, they say nothing about that attempt.
- Only successes are stored: after a definitive refusal the same key may be sent again and runs again.
- The void is naturally idempotent: repeating it returns the same voided load.

## Errors and retries
Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`. Branch on `code`, never on `title` or `detail`.
`detail` follows `Accept-Language` (`en` by default, `es`) and never repeats a value you sent. Retry `429`, `503`,
any other `5xx` and timeouts **with the same Idempotency-Key and the same body**, after `Retry-After` when present.
Never retry any other `4xx` unchanged. `500 internal_error` is an unexpected failure: its body carries only the
problem fields and `request_id`. Another `5xx` may come from OxioPay's edge without a JSON body.

## Rate limits (per connection unless said otherwise)
| Bucket | Limit |
|---|---|
| all calls | 600 a minute |
| money writes (loads and voids) | 120 a minute |
| balance reads per wallet | 12 a minute; per venue night (`business_date`) 120 with a live code and 20 with a ficha; only reads that answered `200` count |
| loads per wallet | 6 a minute |
| `qr` texts that are neither a live code nor a ficha link | 30 a minute; once full, only those texts get `429`: live codes and ficha links keep working |
| failed authentication | per key string: 20 failures in 10 minutes, then that string gets `401 invalid_api_key` for 15 minutes without being looked up; per IP: 20 distinct bad keys in 10 minutes, then `429 rate_limited` for 15 minutes, never for a valid key whose IP list holds that address |

Failures are `invalid_api_key` and `wrong_environment` only. Over a limit → `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`,
the seconds until a call is allowed again (over a per-night limit, until 08:00 Madrid). If a limiter cannot be read
→ `503 try_later`. `429 rate_limited` and `503 try_later` are answered before anything is done.

tags.name: Test helpers (demo only)
tags.description:
**Demo only.** These routes exist only on the demo deployment (test mode with test helpers switched on). In live
they do not exist (404). They act only on the demo fixtures, which hold made-up data.

get.summary: The key's connection, its limits and the terms to show
get.description:
Works with any valid key. Call it when the ATM platform starts and at least once an hour: it gives the issuer
and venue for the ticket, the limits, the terms the ATM shows on screen (read it again whenever a load answer
carries another `terms.version`), the paused scopes and the key's expiry and replacement.

Wallet calls (`/wallet/balance`, loads, voids, `/wallet/operations`, `/statement`) keep the key from going
dormant; `GET /me` does not: 90 days without a wallet call suspend the key (`401 api_key_suspended`).

It answers only while the connection is active: a paused connection gets `403 connection_paused` and a revoked
key `401 api_key_revoked`.

post.summary: Identify a wallet and read its balance
post.description:
POST so the QR text never travels in a URL. Send the exact text the scanner decoded, or the NDEF URI read from
the ficha plus its chip UID. It spends nothing and does not use up a live code.

A wallet outside the key's reach (another wallet group, or a home venue of another company) answers
`404 wallet_not_found`, exactly like an unknown ficha (see Authentication). It does not tell whether a load
would be accepted: the venue's switches, pauses and the load limits are checked only by `POST /wallet/loads`.

200.description: The balance of the identified wallet.

404.description: No wallet within the key's reach matches the reference, or the API is switched off.

409.description: The wallet or the ficha cannot be used.

422.description: The request breaks a rule, or the `qr` text is not a usable wallet reference.

423.description: The venue (or its company) is paused.

post.description:
The owner's call: `qr` + `amount` + `description` + the key, plus the `Idempotency-Key` header, the required
`funding` and the optional `reference` and `device`. Synchronous: `201` means the balance is loaded.

- `Idempotency-Key` = the ATM's own transaction id; `reference` = the same id, so the load can be found by it;
  `device` = the ATM that took the money. See Idempotency for retries.
- **Pilot:** `funding` must be `cash`. `card` answers `422 funding_not_allowed` until OxioPay enables it for the
  connection. `transfer` and `bank_app` are for agent models and answer `422 funding_not_allowed` under
  `venue_collects`.
- A cash load needs the venue's balance and its cash top-ups switched on, as at its reception: otherwise
  `409 method_disabled` with `method: wallet` or `method: cash_top_up`.
- Limits (see `GET /me` → `limits.loads`): per operation, per wallet in 24 h for this connection, per wallet in
  24 h for all partners, per wallet without a contact phone in 30 days for this partner, per connection per
  night → `402 limit_exceeded` naming the limit. Cash into one wallet can never reach 1,000 € in 24 h counting
  reception and every partner together → `402 cash_limit_reached`.
- Loads into one wallet are checked one at a time: two loads that arrive together (two ATMs, or an ATM and
  reception) are checked in turn against every limit, so no limit, the cash rule included, can be passed by
  loading at the same moment. `balance_after` may include another movement made at that moment.
- **Automatic pause** of new loads for the whole connection, until the owner resumes it (meanwhile this route
  answers `403 scope_paused` and `GET /me` lists `wallet:load` in `paused_scopes`; reads and voids keep
  working). Triggers: (1) 3 refusals by `limit_exceeded` with `limit: per_operation` within 10 minutes (the
  same refused request repeated with the same Idempotency-Key and body counts once); (2) more than 30 new loads
  (`201` without `Idempotent-Replayed`) in one minute; (3) 3 voids in one venue night; (4) calls with the key
  from 3 addresses outside its IP list within 24 hours. No other refusal counts. Check the amount against
  `limits.loads.per_operation` before calling.
- The answer carries `terms` (url, version and both summaries): print them on the ticket. With
  `wallet:balance` it also carries `balance_after`.
- A replay returns the stored original `201`. To know the current status of a load, read
  `GET /wallet/loads/{id}`.

201.description: The balance is loaded (or this is the replay of the original answer).

400.description: Malformed request, missing Idempotency-Key, or a key in the URL or body.

402.description: A limit refuses this load. Nothing was loaded. `cash_limit_reached` uses the same status as the other limits.

404.description: No wallet within the key's reach matches the reference, or the API is switched off.

409.description: The wallet or the ficha cannot be used, or the venue switched off balance or cash top-ups.

422.description: The request breaks a rule, the reference is not usable, or the Idempotency-Key was used for another request.

423.description: The venue (or its company) is paused.

get.summary: Read one of this connection's loads
get.description:
Returns the load with its current status. A load the venue voided from its panel also shows
`status: "voided"` and `voided_at`. Another connection's load, or an id that is not one of this connection's
loads, answers `404 load_not_found`. A pause of `wallet:load` does not stop this route.

post.summary: Void one of this connection's loads (within 10 minutes)
post.description:
Removes the full amount of the load from the wallet. Only this connection's own loads, only until `void_until`
(10 minutes after creation), and only while the wallet still holds the amount; the current state of the
wallet, the ficha or the venue (blocked, lost, paused) does not stop it. Use it only when the money of the load
did not stay with the venue (for example the notes went back to the customer). While the ATM still holds the
notes, void first and give them back only after the void answers `200`. It is never a refund: the balance is
not returned in money. The customer gets a notice, and every void is shown to the owner at once.

Naturally idempotent: voiding a voided load returns it again with `200`, at any time. After the window, or when
the balance was already spent, only the venue can correct it from its panel; such a void also shows on the load
(`voided`, `voided_at`) and counts in `/statement` → `load_voids`. A pause of `wallet:load` does not stop
voids; the money freeze (`partner_api_frozen`) does.

409.description: The load can no longer be voided through the API. Nothing changed.

get.description:
Give **either** `business_date` **or** `from` and `to` (at most 31 days). Both, neither, only one of `from`
and `to`, or a `to` not after `from` → `422 validation_failed`, with `param` naming the first parameter at
fault. Optional exact `reference`. Oldest first (by `created_at`, then `id`). Each load appears once, under
its creation time, with its current status: a voided load, whether this connection or the venue voided it,
shows `status: "voided"` and `voided_at`. A row appears when its transaction commits: read a night once it has
ended (after 08:05 Madrid) for a complete list. A pause of `wallet:load` does not stop this route.

get.summary: Totals of this connection's loads and voids in a period
get.description:
The same numbers as the owner's "Movimientos" screen for this connection. Loads count at their creation time,
voids at the time of the void, whether this connection or the venue (from its panel) voided them. Under
`venue_collects` the money of these loads is already the venue's; nobody owes anything through the API.
Settlement between the ATM operator and the venue is outside the API. A pause of `wallet:load` does not stop
this route.

In this pilot the statement holds only the loads block; blocks for other scopes come with those features.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the period, included. RFC 3339 (`Z` or an offset).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the period, excluded. At most 92 days after `from`.

get.description: Public, no key needed. Answers 404 while the partner API is switched off.

200.description: The OpenAPI 3.1 document of the partner API.

post.summary: Demo only: mint an identify-only live code for a fixture
post.description:
**Demo only.** Mints a live code for a fixture wallet, the same as the code the customer would show from their
wallet page. In this pilot every live code is identify-only: it serves for balance and loads and lives 60
seconds. Show it as a QR code (alphanumeric mode) on a phone or a screen to test the ATM's scanner, or send
it as `qr` directly.

This is the only answer that carries a live code, and only for made-up fixtures.

post.summary: Demo only: put every fixture back to its seeded state
post.description:
**Demo only.** Gives every fixture a fresh wallet with its seeded balance and state; the fixtures keep the same
ficha links and chip UIDs. Loads already made stay in `/wallet/operations` and `/statement` but no longer count
toward the fixtures' limits; the connection's own night limit (`connection_night`) still counts them. Live
codes minted before stop working. The fixtures are shared by everyone testing on the demo: expect loads and
resets by other testers. No body (send no `Content-Type`).

204.description: The fixtures are back to their seeded state.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: oxp_live_ or oxp_test_ followed by 48 lowercase hex characters
bearerAuth.description:
`Authorization: Bearer oxp_live_<48 hex>` in live, `Bearer oxp_test_<48 hex>` on the demo. Live refuses test
keys and the demo refuses live keys (`401 wrong_environment`). The key is shown only once: when the owner
creates or rotates it, OxioPay emails a one-time claim link (valid 24 hours) to the partner's registered
contact email, or the owner hands it over directly. A rotation or a renewal keeps the connection: the same
`pc_` id, the same loads and the same Idempotency-Keys. During a rotation overlap `GET /me` with the old key
shows `key.replaced: true`. Keep the key on the ATM platform's servers only.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
The ATM's own transaction id: unique per connection forever, the same on every retry of that transaction.
When it is also your `reference` (as recommended), use 8 to 64 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`, and end it with a
few random characters so that nobody can guess the next one. Missing → `400 idempotency_key_missing`. Present
but not matching the pattern → `400 invalid_request` with `param: "Idempotency-Key"`. Ignored on routes that do
not require it.

XRequestId.name: X-Request-Id
XRequestId.description: Your own id for this request, echoed in `Request-Id` when it matches the pattern; otherwise ignored and OxioPay generates a UUID.

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Language of the problem `detail`. Spanish when the first language is `es`; English otherwise. `title` is always English.

LoadId.name: id
LoadId.description: The load id (`wl_` + 32 hex). Anything that is not one of this connection's loads answers `404 load_not_found`.

BusinessDate.name: business_date
BusinessDate.description: The venue's night (08:00 to 08:00 Europe/Madrid), named after the day it starts. Use it instead of `from` and `to`.

From.name: from
From.description: Start, included. With `to`, instead of `business_date`. RFC 3339 (`Z` or an offset).

To.name: to
To.description: End, excluded. At most 31 days after `from`; may be in the future.

ReferenceFilter.name: reference
ReferenceFilter.description: Only loads whose `reference` is exactly this text.

OperationType.name: type
OperationType.description: `load`. In this pilot the list holds only loads; `payment` comes with paying with balance.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, sent with the same filters. A cursor that cannot be read with these filters → `422 validation_failed` (`param: "cursor"`).

RequestId.description: The id of this request (your valid `X-Request-Id`, or a UUID). Also in every problem as `request_id`.

IdempotentReplayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, when the answer is the stored answer of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Over a per-night limit, the seconds until 08:00 Madrid.

BadRequest.description:
`invalid_request`: the body is not a JSON object (an array, a string, an empty body where one is needed), the
content type is not `application/json`, or the request cannot be read (`param` when it names one place).
`api_key_in_url` / `api_key_in_body`: a key was sent outside the Authorization header.

Unauthorized.description: The key is not usable. Do not retry; the ATM platform's operators must act.

ForbiddenAnyScope.description: Refused before any data is read.

ForbiddenScoped.description: Refused before any data is read, or the key lacks the scope (or `wallet:balance` is paused).

ForbiddenRead.description:
Refused before any data is read, or the key lacks the scope. A pause of `wallet:load` and the money freeze do
not refuse this route: an open transaction can always be looked up and reconciled.

ForbiddenVoid.description:
As `ForbiddenRead`, plus `partner_api_frozen` when OxioPay froze money operations. A pause of `wallet:load` does
not refuse a void.

ForbiddenMoney.description:
As for any scoped route, plus `scope_paused` while new loads are paused and `partner_api_frozen` when OxioPay
froze money operations.

ApiOff.description:
`not_found`: the partner API is switched off, frozen for every route, or the route does not exist here (the
test helpers in live). When the API is switched off the body may not be problem+json: treat any 404 on
`/me` as "API unavailable".

LoadNotFound.description: Not one of this connection's loads, or the API is switched off.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The body is larger than 16 KB (16,384 bytes).

RateLimited.description:
Too many requests; nothing was done. Retry after `Retry-After`, with the same Idempotency-Key and body. See the
rate-limit table for each bucket.

TryLater.description:
OxioPay cannot answer safely right now, and nothing was done: a limiter or the live-code store cannot be read
(while that store is down every call answers `503`, fichas included, because the limits fail closed), or an
earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key is still running. Retry after `Retry-After`, with the same
Idempotency-Key and body.

ValidationFailed.description: A field breaks its rule; `param` names it.

ValidationFailedFixture.description: A field breaks its rule; `param` names it.

RangeOrValidation.description: `range_too_long`: the period is longer than 31 days. `validation_failed`: a parameter breaks its rule (`param`).

StatementRangeOrValidation.description: `range_too_long`: the period is longer than 92 days. `validation_failed`: a parameter breaks its rule (`param`).

ServerError.description:
OxioPay failed. `500 internal_error` carries only the problem fields and `request_id`; another `5xx` may come
from OxioPay's edge, and its body may not be JSON. For a load the result is unknown: retry with the same
Idempotency-Key and body.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC (`Z`). Clients accept fractional seconds. Times sent in requests may use `Z` or an offset.

Scope.description: The ATM key holds `wallet:balance` and `wallet:load` only. The other scopes belong to features outside this pilot.

Qr.description:
The exact text the QR scanner decoded, or the NDEF URI read from the ficha's chip with its URI prefix expanded
(`https://…`), trimmed and otherwise unmodified. Never a typed code, a phone number, an internal id or a PIN.

Send only texts that start with `OXC1:`, `NPF:` or `https://`, or that are exactly 6 letters or digits. For
anything else (contact cards, Wi-Fi codes, other payment QRs, plain text) show the `wallet_ref_unrecognized`
text without calling OxioPay.

Accepted:
- a **live code** `OXC1:` + 26 Crockford base32 characters, shown on the customer's own wallet page under
  "Pagar o recargar en otro sistema". In this pilot it identifies only (balance and loads) and lives 60 seconds;
- a **ficha link** `https://<host>/?ficha=<token>` as written on the chip (or printed as a QR).

Refused with `422 wallet_ref_not_accepted`, with `reason`: the Google Wallet pass `https://<host>/c/…`
(`wallet_pass`); the wallet's own private link `/w/<token>` and its sub-pages (`private_link`); the reception QR
`NPF:…` (`reception_qr`); the 6-character wallet code, or a link carrying `?saldo=` (`short_code`); charge links
`/s/…`, `/pay/…` (`charge_link`); activation `/w/a/…`, the ficha's own page `/w/card/…`, `/w/salida/…`,
`/w/no/…`, reservation and gift links (`other_link`). The refusal and its `reason` depend only on the text's
shape: the same answer whether the link or code is valid, unknown or of another company. Anything else →
`422 wallet_ref_unrecognized`. An expired or unknown live code → `422 live_code_invalid`.

Never store or log it.

NfcUid.description:
The chip's serial (UID, ISO/IEC 14443-3) in hex: 4, 7 or 10 bytes, in the order the chip sends them during
anticollision. That is the order Android's `Tag.getId()` and PC/SC `GET DATA` (`FF CA 00 00 00`) return, and
the order OxioPay stores: the venues' NTAG213/215/216 fichas have 7 bytes starting with `04`
(`04A1B2C3D4E5F6`). With or without `:`, `-` or a space between bytes; case is ignored. Never reversed and
never as a decimal number: a serial in another form does not match the stored one, answers
`409 ficha_copy_suspected` and raises an alert to the owner.

Send it whenever the ficha was read by NFC, and only then: with a live code it answers `422 validation_failed`
(`param: "nfc_uid"`). When OxioPay holds a different serial for that ficha → `409 ficha_copy_suspected`. A
ficha without a stored serial, or a ficha link sent without `nfc_uid`, is treated as a plain ficha link (a
copy cannot be detected then). OxioPay never stores the serial you send. Never store or log it beyond the
transaction.

Description.description:
Required. 1 to 60 Unicode code points after trimming, NFC normalisation and collapsing inner whitespace (send it
already normalised). The customer sees it as "Carga · {partner_name}: {description}" in their movements; the
owner sees it in the panel.

`422 description_invalid`: control or format characters (zero-width characters, bidi overrides U+202A–U+202E
and U+2066–U+2069, U+FEFF), line or paragraph separators, `<` or `>`, URLs or domains (`://`, `www.`,
`word.tld`).
`422 description_personal_data`: anything that looks like an email; 9 or more digits in a row once spaces,
dots, dashes, `·` and `/` are removed (phones, card numbers, long serial numbers); any run of 13 to 19 digits
that passes the Luhn check. Never write anything that reveals a personal service.

Reference.description:
Your own id for the operation (use the ATM transaction id). Never personal data: no card number, phone, email
or name; a run of 13 to 19 digits that passes the Luhn check → `422 validation_failed` (`param: "reference"`).
Never shown to the customer; searchable by the owner; not unique.

Device.description:
The ATM that took the money (for example `ATM0042`). Send it on every load. It is part of the request for
idempotency, is stored with the load and is shown to the owner, never to the customer. OxioPay watches cash
split across several wallets per ATM with it.

Funding.description:
How the customer paid the load. Under `venue_collects` only `cash` and `card` (a payment on the venue's own
card terminal) are accepted; `transfer` and `bank_app` belong to agent models → `422 funding_not_allowed`.
**ATM pilot: only `cash`.** `card` answers `422 funding_not_allowed` until OxioPay enables it for the connection.

Issuer.description: The company that issues the balance (the venue's company). OxioPay is its technical provider. Print it on the ticket.

legal_name.description:
The company's legal name, as registered in OxioPay. A key is only issued for a venue whose company has a
tax id on file. If the venue later has no company, or its company no tax id, every route of the connection
answers `403 connection_paused` until OxioPay fixes it: an answer never comes without `issuer`.

tax_id.description: The company's tax id (NIF/CIF), uppercase, without spaces or dashes.

hint.description: The key's prefix and last 4 characters.

expires_at.description:
When this key stops working (at most 365 days after its creation; always set for a key with `wallet:load`).
During a rotation overlap, the end of the overlap. To renew before it, ask the owner for a rotation with a
7-day overlap at least 30 days before.

replaced.description:
`true` when the owner has rotated this key: a new key was sent through the one-time claim link and this one
works only until `expires_at`. Alert your operators at once.

LoadLimits.description:
The limits that apply to this connection's loads, in cents. Each one is also the `limit` value of
`402 limit_exceeded`, except `cash_wallet_24h`, whose refusal is `402 cash_limit_reached`.

per_operation.description: Most one load may carry. Default 30000 (300 €); the owner may set up to 99999.

wallet_24h.description: Loads minus voids by this connection into one wallet (with the wallets merged into it) in the last 24 hours. Default 60000; owner up to 99999.

wallet_24h_all_partners.description: Loads minus voids by every partner into one wallet in the last 24 hours, any funding. Fixed.

unnamed_wallet_30d.description:
Loads minus voids by this partner (all its connections) into one wallet without a contact phone, in the
last 30 days, any funding. Fixed at 1,500 €. Above it the customer asks the venue's manager to record their
phone.

connection_night.description:
Loads minus voids by this connection in the venue's current night. Default 500000; owner up to 5000000.
It is also the most a leaked key can load per venue and night: OxioPay cannot see the cash, so the venue's
count of each ATM against `GET /statement` is the check. OxioPay alerts the owner when a night's loads reach
half of this limit, and again when they reach it.

cash_wallet_24h.description: Cash into one wallet in the last 24 hours, counting reception and every partner together (Ley 7/2012). Fixed. The total can never reach 100000.

Terms.description:
The balance terms. The ATM shows `summary_es` or `summary_en` (the customer's language) from `GET /me` on screen
before taking the money, and prints the `terms` of the load answer (summary, `url` and `version`) on the
ticket. The summary, `url` and `version` always come from OxioPay, never from a copy kept in the ATM's code.

url.description: The balance section of OxioPay's Conditions page.

version.description: The revision date of the terms (YYYY-MM-DD).

partner_name.description: The partner's name as customers see it ("Carga · {partner_name}: {description}").

venue_name.description: The venue this key belongs to.

collection_model.description: Who collects the money of a load. The ATM pilot is `venue_collects`: the cash belongs to the venue.

status.description: Always `active` in an answer; a paused or revoked connection is refused before.

scopes.description: The scopes the key holds now.

paused_scopes.description:
Scopes paused by an automatic pause, by the owner or by OxioPay. A paused `wallet:load` refuses only new
loads (`POST /wallet/loads` → `403 scope_paused`): reading loads, voiding and reconciling keep working. A
paused `wallet:balance` refuses `POST /wallet/balance`.

Connection.description:
In this pilot the connection carries no `credit` block (agent models only) and no `webhook` block (webhooks
come after the pilot); both will be added without breaking anything.

WalletBalance.description: Nothing else is ever returned about the wallet.

available.description: The live wallet's balance in cents (0 when it is empty).

amount.description: Cents, from 1 to 99999 (999.99 €). The connection's limits apply on top.

reference.description: Your reference, or null when none was sent.

device.description: The ATM you sent in `device`, or null when none was sent.

void_until.description: `created_at` + 10 minutes: the last moment `POST /wallet/loads/{id}/void` accepts it.

balance_after.description:
The wallet's balance right after this load was made, in cents, as stored then. It does not change with a
void or later movements, so the read and void answers repeat it. Only when the key holds `wallet:balance`.

voided_at.description: In the answers of `GET /wallet/loads/{id}`, the void and the list (null while not voided). Not in the create answer.

reason.description:
Optional. Why the load is voided, for the venue. Same text rules as `description`, but a broken rule
answers `422 validation_failed` (`param: "reason"`). Never shown to the customer.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` to read the next page; null on the last page.

loads.description: This connection's loads created in the period.

load_voids.description: Voids of this connection's loads made in the period, by this connection or by the venue from its panel, whenever the load was made.

net_loads.description: `loads.amount` − `load_voids.amount`, in cents (negative when the period holds voids of earlier loads).

OperationRef.description: The operation that already holds this Idempotency-Key.

Fixture.description:
Demo fixtures (made-up data). Each has a fixed ficha link `https://demo-operator.oxiopay.example/?ficha=<token>`:

| fixture | token | chip UID stored | balance | what it answers |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | `demo-ficha-active-0001` | none | 5000 | works |
| `empty` | `demo-ficha-empty-00001` | none | 0 | balance 0; a load works |
| `ficha_uid` | `demo-ficha-uid-0000001` | `04A1B2C3D4E5F6` | 5000 | works; another UID → `409 ficha_copy_suspected` |
| `blocked` | `demo-ficha-blocked-001` | none | 5000 | `409 wallet_blocked` |
| `closed` | `demo-ficha-closed-0001` | none | 0 | `409 wallet_closed` |
| `lost_ficha` | `demo-ficha-lost-000001` | none | 5000 | the ficha → `409 ficha_lost`; a live code of its wallet works |
| `ficha_blocked` | `demo-ficha-fblocked-01` | none | 5000 | the ficha → `409 ficha_blocked`; a live code of its wallet works |
| `other_group` | `demo-ficha-othergroup1` | none | 5000 | `404 wallet_not_found` (another wallet group) |
| `other_company` | `demo-ficha-othercomp01` | none | 5000 | `404 wallet_not_found` (same group, another company) |

No fixture has a contact phone. Every test key is issued for the demo venue "Local Demo Centro" (or another
venue of its company and wallet group), the only venues that reach these fixtures; they are shared by everyone
testing on the demo.

Demo sample texts. The refusal depends only on the text's shape, so these made-up texts give these answers:

| `qr` | answer |
|---|---|
| `https://demo-api.oxiopay.example/c/demoGoogleWalletPass00000000000000000000001` | `422 wallet_ref_not_accepted`, `reason: wallet_pass` |
| `https://demo-api.oxiopay.example/w/demoPrivateLink000000001` | `reason: private_link` |
| `NPF:K7Q4M2:demoReceptionProof0001` | `reason: reception_qr` |
| `K7Q4M2` | `reason: short_code` |
| `https://demo-api.oxiopay.example/pay/demoChargeLink000000000000000001` | `reason: charge_link` |
| `https://demo-api.oxiopay.example/w/a/demoActivationLink000001` | `reason: other_link` |
| `https://example.org/carta` | `422 wallet_ref_unrecognized` |

On request, OxioPay puts the demo connection or venue in the states that answer `method_disabled`,
`venue_paused`, `partner_api_frozen`, `connection_paused` and `scope_paused`, and back.

TestLiveCodeRequest.description: In this pilot only `fixture`; `can_pay` and `max` come with paying with balance.

code.description: An identify-only live code for the fixture's wallet.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable snake_case code. Codes that can appear in this pilot:
`invalid_request`, `idempotency_key_missing`, `api_key_in_url`, `api_key_in_body`, `invalid_api_key`,
`api_key_rotated`, `api_key_revoked`, `api_key_expired`, `api_key_suspended`, `wrong_environment`,
`limit_exceeded`, `cash_limit_reached`, `scope_missing`, `scope_paused`, `ip_not_allowed`,
`browser_not_allowed`, `partner_suspended`, `connection_paused`, `partner_api_frozen`, `wallet_not_found`,
`load_not_found`, `not_found`, `wallet_blocked`, `wallet_closed`, `ficha_lost`, `ficha_blocked`,
`ficha_copy_suspected`, `method_disabled`, `void_window_passed`, `balance_already_spent`, `body_too_large`,
`validation_failed`, `wallet_ref_unrecognized`, `wallet_ref_not_accepted`, `live_code_invalid`,
`description_invalid`, `description_personal_data`, `funding_not_allowed`, `idempotency_key_reused`,
`range_too_long`, `venue_paused`, `rate_limited`, `try_later`, `internal_error`.

Problem.description:
RFC 9457 problem details. Branch on `code`. The extension members appear only with the codes named in their
description.

title.description: Short summary in English, fixed per code.

detail.description:
Explanation for developers, in the language of `Accept-Language`. It never repeats a value you sent. The ATM
shows its own texts to customers.

param.description: `invalid_request` (when it names one place) and `validation_failed`: the field, query parameter or header at fault.

required_scope.description: `scope_missing` only: the scope the route needs.

limit.description:
`limit_exceeded` only: which limit refused the load. When several would, the first in this order is named:
`per_operation`, `wallet_24h`, `wallet_24h_all_partners`, `unnamed_wallet_30d`, `connection_night`; the
cash rule (`cash_limit_reached`) is checked after all of them.

remaining.description:
`limit_exceeded` with `limit` `per_operation`, `wallet_24h`, `unnamed_wallet_30d` or `connection_night`:
cents that limit still allows now. Never with `wallet_24h_all_partners` nor with `cash_limit_reached`
(it would reveal what other channels loaded).

method.description:
`method_disabled` only: the switch the venue turned off: `wallet` (balance payments and loads) or
`cash_top_up` (cash top-ups, which a cash load needs as at the venue's reception).

reason.description:
`method_disabled`: `venue_setting` (the owner switched it off in the venue's settings).
`wallet_ref_not_accepted`: what the customer showed: `wallet_pass` (Google Wallet pass `/c/…`),
`private_link` (the wallet's own private link `/w/<token>` or one of its sub-pages), `reception_qr`
(`NPF:…`), `short_code` (the 6-character wallet code, or a link carrying `?saldo=`), `charge_link` (`/s/…`,
`/pay/…`: a charge, not a wallet), `other_link` (activation `/w/a/…`, the ficha's own page `/w/card/…`,
`/w/salida/…`, `/w/no/…`, reservation or gift link).

available.description: `balance_already_spent`, only when the key holds `wallet:balance`: the wallet's balance now, in cents.
